bar: bar / barem — at least, at the very least
da: conjunction: that, so that; da + verb = infinitive («da vidim» — to see); also «yes»
devedesetim: devedesete — the nineties (years); u devedesetim — in the nineties
dobro: dobro veče — good evening; dobro je što — good thing that
dvije: dvije (andјekavian, Bosnia) = dve; fem. of dva
ga: short form of njega; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
godini: godina; loc. case: na prvoj godini — in the first year
i: conjunction; before the word — «and, also, even»
idem: ići — to go, to ride; 1st pers. sg.
izgleda: izgledati — to look; also parenthetical «apparently, seemingly»
izlaziš: izlaziti — to go out; 2nd pers. sg.
izvinila: izviniti se — to apologize; past, fem.
je: biti — to be, 3rd pers. sg.; auxiliary verb past; je l' — «really, or what»
jesi: biti, 2nd pers. sg., full form; in questions: jesi siguran? — you're sure?
ko: ko zna — who knows; colloquial abbreviation of kao — «how»
kukam: kukati — to whine, to complain; 1st pers. sg.
liježe: lijegati (andјekavian) = legati; plata liježe — salary arrives in the account
marke: marka — convertible mark, currency of Bosnia and Herzegovina
materijala: materijal; gen.; nema materijala — here: nothing to take
meni: full form dat. case of ja
mi: mi — we; short form «me» (potreban mi je — I need)
moraš: morati; 2nd pers. sg.: ne moraš — not necessarily
na: preposition: na jugu — in the south, na Instagram — in Instagram
najgora: najgori, najgora — worst; superlative of loš
nema: nemati — not to have; nema znaka — there is no sign
ni: nije čak ni selo — this is not even a village
ništa: at the beginning of a sentence — «well then, anyway»
od: preposition + gen. case: jedno od naselja — one of the settlements
pa: particle at the start of a line — «well»; conjunction — «and, therefore»
po: doći po pare — to come for the money; po jedan — one by one
radi: raditi — to work, to do; 3rd pers. sg.
sam: biti, 1st pers. sg.: rekao sam — I said
se: reflexive particle: slikamo se — we take photos of ourselves
si: biti, 2nd pers. sg.; gde si — hi, how are you (colloquial)
sjedni: sjesti (andјekavian) = sesti — to sit down; imperative
slikama: slika — photograph, picture; loc. case pl.
ti: pronoun; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
u: preposition: + loc. case — where, + acc. case — where to
veze: veza — connection, relationship (with a boyfriend/girlfriend); gen.
već: adverb «already»; after negation — «a» (nije selo već gradić)
vrijedi: vrijediti (andјekavian) = vredeti — to cost, to be valid
za: preposition: za to — for this; skretanje za — turn onto
šuti: šutjeti — to be silent (Bosnia, Croatia) = ćutati; imperative
